failure.observedScreenshot: Current password input rendered visibly with required asterisk; error-context has accessible textbox name Current password
failure.locatorFinding: Pinned Playwright label engine uses elementText, including aria-hidden asterisk. Required label text is Current password *; exact Current password label query does not match. No field or label removal proposed.
failure.sameSiteFinding: erp.browser.invalid and site.browser.invalid share registrable browser.invalid. Initial Strict source cookie was sent (true); existing later not-contains assertion was not reached after timeout.
failure.proposedCorrectionScope: Fixture-only explicit input identity plus accessible-name/required/autocomplete assertions; use distinct source.invalid registrable domain and assert initial Strict cookie absence before Continue. No runtime guard change.
